Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 52

“When your understanding crosses beyond the thicket of delusion, then you will grow indifferent to all that has been heard and all that is yet to be heard.”

Thicket catches the experience exactly — delusion as dense undergrowth rather than as darkness. Beyond it, the endless appetite for more teaching quiets, because the need it fed is gone.
